Certified Products
Nonfat Dry Milk, Low Heat (RB-4410) • Sweet Cream Buttermilk Powder (RB-4420) • Lactose, Edible Grade (RB-4455)

The products listed above are certified to the GFCO standard, which requires that finished product contain no more than 10 ppm gluten. This is a stricter requirement than the United States federal labelling rule at 21 CFR 101.91, which permits a food to be labelled gluten-free at less than 20 ppm.

Certification is maintained by annual on-site inspection, ingredient review, and analytical verification of finished product by R5 competitive ELISA. Certification does not transfer to products, formulations or facilities not listed above.
